items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Shine, the drummer they call Shine. Oh, yes. He was playing drums with us.

ctx.x: Alvin Alcon, George, and Shine, the drummer they call Shine. Oh, yes. He was playing drums with us. And Pop Kimball, he was a bass, tuba player. Yes. Let's see. Hal Desjohn, he was a saxophone player. Oh, yes. He's still there. And Lucian Johnson was a saxophone player. They had a reed session.
